419606e87b4a: Read a passage before you translate · translationCore 4 Help
bcafa7720d63: Many teams read and talk about a passage here before they draft it.
ff749b696f71: Open a book, then click Understand at the top.
44e086f6011e: Choose the source text with the ULT or UST tab. Projects with a Spanish checking language show GLT and GST instead.
fd228361bd37: Next to Comment by, choose Section to read a section at a time, or Verse for one verse at a time.
15b2c0fc90be: Read the helps on the right: Notes, Words, Questions and UST. Click a help card and the words it is about are highlighted in the passage.
23260f03a26c: To keep a thought for later, type it in the comment box under the section. See Write a user comment.
f4cf47fb096e: A small green dot on a section means you wrote a comment there.
ab2dbdc038e5: Sections follow the breaks in the source text, so a chapter can split differently in different gateway languages.
41bcd926695c: Your choice of Section or Verse is shared with Translate.
52372b78ed9b: Understand shows the gateway texts. The Greek or Hebrew is in Translate and Check.
